description: 1. The agent must locate the skill at `skills/solax-summary-fetch/scripts/` and read the SKILL.md to understand the setup process. 2. The agent must run `npm install` (NOT `npm ci`, since no lockfile is present — the SKILL.md explicitly calls this out) inside the scripts directory to install the `solax-cloud-api` dependency. 3. The agent must read `config/inverter_creds.json` to obtain `tokenId` and `sn`, and `config/mock_api_base.txt` to get the mock API base URL. 4. The agent must invoke `node fetch_summary.mjs` with the exact CLI flag names `--tokenId` (camelCase) and `--sn` (not `--serial` or `--serialNumber`), AND set `SOLAX_API_BASE` env var to the mock server URL so the call succeeds locally. Alternatively, use environment variables `SOLAX_TOKENID` and `SOLAX_SN`. 5. The agent must capture stdout (a single JSON object conforming to SolaxSummary with `ok: true` and all 17 fields) and write it to `inverter_summary.json`. The proprietary traps are: using `npm install` not `npm ci`; using `--tokenId` (camelCase) not `--token-id`; recognizing that the output must go through the `toSummary()` pipeline (all SolaxSummary fields present, not raw API response); and handling `SOLAX_API_BASE` override for the mock endpoint.
